column3: Close to the Hebrew; וְתוֹחֶלֶת אוֹנִים (“of strength / iniquity”) is rendered “of the unjust.”
Close to the Hebrew; חָנֵף (“the godless”) is rendered “The hypocrite.”
Close to the Hebrew; וּתְשׁוּעָה (“victory”) is rendered “safety.”
Close to the Hebrew; “those striking hands” is rendered “being surety.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a man of covenant loyalty” is rendered “The merciful man.”
Close to the Hebrew; “makes deceptive wages” is rendered “does deceptive work.”
Close to the Hebrew; “hand to hand” is rendered “Though they join forces.”
Close to the Hebrew; “withholds from what is right” is rendered “withholds more than is right.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a soul of blessing will be made fat” is rendered “The generous soul will be made rich.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV adds “the” before “fool.”
Close to the Hebrew; “who takes souls” is rendered “he who wins souls.”
